Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

Procurement summary for FinOpsCo:
- AP policy: vendor contracts > $10k/year require a purchase order and vendor onboarding.
- One-off purchases or pilot spends under $2k can be paid by corporate card.
- We prefer Marketplace purchases when available since billing and entitlements are automated, but we need the vendor to be listed (AWS Marketplace or our preferred procurement channel).

Required items to start onboarding:
- Completed vendor form (we'll send separately)
- W-9 (tax form)
- Proof of SOC 2 or a security questionnaire response (we can accept attestation + date of last audit)

Timing: once we have the full packet, AP typically takes 2-3 weeks to complete onboarding and issue the first PO. If this is time-sensitive, card payment for the pilot is our fastest route. 

Can you send the W-9 and SOC 2 attestation? Also confirm if Redwood is available on AWS Marketplace or if we should proceed with a standard PO.

Best,
Sasha Ivanov
Head of Procurement | FinOpsCo

Marissa / Sasha —

Following up from AP with formal constraints and next steps from FinOpsCo's side. 

AP constraints / requirements:
- Vendor onboarding: 2-3 weeks after receiving the complete vendor packet (vendor form, W-9, COI if > $10k exposure, security questionnaire).
- PO issuance: POs are issued on a monthly cycle; once onboarding is complete we will target issuance on the next cycle (please expect up to 4 weeks in worst case).
- Payment methods: ACH or corporate card. Card payments are used only for one-off charges and typically limited to <$2,000 per transaction. Recurring contracts and expected spend >$10k/year must be on PO/ACH.
- Terms: our standard is Net-30. If Redwood needs different terms, please flag now so we can route for approval.

Required documents to start onboarding (please send to vendor-admin@finopsco.com):
- Completed vendor form (I will email the form separately)
- W-9 (PDF)
- Security questionnaire or SOC 2 Type II attestation (if you prefer, we can accept a signed SOC 2 attestation + date)
- Invoice remit/billing contact and email (we use ap@finopsco.com for invoices)

If you can provide the vendor packet and W-9 by EOD tomorrow, we will kick off onboarding and provide a more precise PO issuance estimate. If you prefer to do a short pilot quicker, card payment for month 1 is feasible but will require a follow-up to convert to PO if you proceed.

CC'ing Sasha for visibility. Happy to hop on a quick call with Marissa and our procurement owner if you want to walk through the packet live.

Thanks,
Priyanka Desai
Accounts Payable Manager | FinOpsCo
